findings: The documented SideStore route uses a separate VPN app; it does not satisfy the single-app requirement.
Apple's capability table does not list Network Extensions or Personal VPN for free Apple Developer provisioning; copying the packet-tunnel extension is not a verified solution.
The actual idevice dependency also has a userspace CDTunnel adapter. Its ordinary outer TCP connection and authenticated same-device protocol still require device evidence.
RemotePairing's initial, TLS, RSD and service ports can be discovered or negotiated dynamically. Fixed-port refusal cannot establish a universal impossibility result.
No supported free-team direct installation API was established. Private symbol existence is not evidence of usable installation permission.
iOS schedules background tasks; even a future working foreground renewal path would not establish reliable unattended renewal.
